verses.original: חֲמוֹתָ֑הּ נָעֳמִ֣י וַתֹּ֥אמֶר לָ֖הּ בִּתִּ֞י הֲלֹ֧א אֲבַקֶּשׁ־ מָנ֖וֹחַ לָ֛ךְ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִֽיטַב־ לָֽךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·mō·w·ṯāh nā·‘o·mî wat·tō·mer lāh bit·tî hă·lō ’ă·ḇaq·qeš- mā·nō·w·aḥ lāḵ ’ă·šer yî·ṭaḇ- lāḵ
verses.literal: One day Ruth’s mother-in-law Naomi said to her My daughter should I not seek a resting place for you that it may be well with you

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה הֲלֹ֥א בֹ֙עַז֙ אֶת־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נַעֲרוֹתָ֑יו הָיִ֖ית מֹֽדַעְתָּ֔נוּ הִנֵּה־ הַלָּֽיְלָה׃ ה֗וּא זֹרֶ֛ה אֶת־ הַשְּׂעֹרִ֖ים גֹּ֥רֶן
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hă·lō ḇō·‘az ’eṯ- ’ă·šer na·‘ă·rō·w·ṯāw hā·yîṯ mō·ḏa‘·tā·nū hin·nêh- hal·lā·yə·lāh hū zō·reh ’eṯ- haś·śə·‘ō·rîm gō·ren
verses.literal: Now is not Boaz with whose servant girls you have been [working] a relative of ours In fact tonight he is winnowing - barley on the threshing floor

verses.original: וְרָחַ֣צְתְּ׀ וָסַ֗כְתְּ וְשַׂ֧מְתְּ שִׂמְלֹתֵךְ עָלַ֖יִךְ וְיָרַדְתִּי הַגֹּ֑רֶן אַל־ לָאִ֔ישׁ תִּוָּדְעִ֣י עַ֥ד כַּלֹּת֖וֹ לֶאֱכֹ֥ל וְלִשְׁתּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·ḥaṣt wā·saḵt wə·śamt śim·lō·ṯēḵ ‘ā·la·yiḵ wə·yå̄·raḏ·tī hag·gō·ren ’al- lā·’îš tiw·wā·ḏə·‘î ‘aḏ kal·lō·ṯōw le·’ĕ·ḵōl wə·liš·tō·wṯ
verses.literal: Therefore wash yourself put on perfume and wear your best clothes . . . Go down to the threshing floor but do not let the man know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking

verses.original: וִיהִ֣י בְשָׁכְב֗וֹ וְיָדַ֙עַתְּ֙ אֶת־ הַמָּקוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִשְׁכַּב־ שָׁ֔ם וּבָ֛את וְגִלִּ֥ית מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖יו וְשָׁכָבְתִּי וְהוּא֙ יַגִּ֣יד לָ֔ךְ אֵ֖ת אֲשֶׁ֥ר תַּעַשִֽׂין׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî ḇə·šā·ḵə·ḇōw wə·yā·ḏa·‘at ’eṯ- ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiš·kaḇ- šām ū·ḇāṯ wə·ḡil·lîṯ mar·gə·lō·ṯāw wə·šå̄·ḵå̄·ḇə·tī wə·hū yag·gîḏ lāḵ ’êṯ ’ă·šer ta·ʿa·śīn
verses.literal: - When he lies down note - the place where he lies . . . Then go in and uncover his feet and lie down and he will explain to you - what you should do

verses.original: אֶֽעֱשֶֽׂה׃ כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמְרִ֥יֵַ֖ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר אֵלֶ֑יהָ
verses.literal: I will do everything - you say [Ruth] answered -

verses.original: וַתֵּ֖רֶד הַגֹּ֑רֶן וַתַּ֕עַשׂ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ חֲמוֹתָֽהּ׃ צִוַּ֖תָּה
verses.transliteration: wat·tê·reḏ hag·gō·ren wat·ta·‘aś kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ḥă·mō·w·ṯāh ṣiw·wat·tāh
verses.literal: So she went down to the threshing floor and did everything - her mother-in-law had instructed her [to do]

verses.original: בֹּ֤עַז וַיֹּ֨אכַל וַיֵּשְׁתְּ֙ וַיִּיטַ֣ב לִבּ֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֕א לִשְׁכַּ֖ב בִּקְצֵ֣ה הָעֲרֵמָ֑ה וַתָּבֹ֣א בַלָּ֔ט וַתְּגַ֥ל מַרְגְּלֹתָ֖יו וַתִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.transliteration: bō·‘az way·yō·ḵal way·yê·šət way·yî·ṭaḇ lib·bōw way·yā·ḇō liš·kaḇ biq·ṣêh hā·‘ă·rê·māh wat·tā·ḇō ḇal·lāṭ wat·tə·ḡal mar·gə·lō·ṯāw wat·tiš·kāḇ
verses.literal: After Boaz had finished eating and drinking and was in good spirits . . . he went to lie down at the end of the heap of grain Then [Ruth] went in secretly . . . uncovered his feet and lay down

verses.original: וַיְהִי֙ בַּחֲצִ֣י הַלַּ֔יְלָה הָאִ֖ישׁ וַיֶּחֱרַ֥ד וַיִּלָּפֵ֑ת וְהִנֵּ֣ה שֹׁכֶ֖בֶת מַרְגְּלֹתָֽיו׃ אִשָּׁ֔ה
verses.transliteration: way·hî ba·ḥă·ṣî hal·lay·lāh hā·’îš way·ye·ḥĕ·raḏ way·yil·lā·p̄êṯ wə·hin·nêh šō·ḵe·ḇeṯ mar·gə·lō·ṯāw ’iš·šāh
verses.literal: - At midnight . . . Boaz was startled turned over and there lying at his feet was a woman

verses.original: מִי־ אָ֑תּ וַיֹּ֖אמֶר אָנֹכִי֙ אֲמָתֶ֔ךָ ר֣וּת וַתֹּ֗אמֶר וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֤ כְנָפֶ֙ךָ֙ עַל־ אֲמָ֣תְךָ֔ כִּ֥י אָֽתָּה׃ גֹאֵ֖ל
verses.transliteration: mî- ʾå̄t way·yō·mer ’ā·nō·ḵî ’ă·mā·ṯe·ḵā rūṯ wat·tō·mer ū·p̄ā·raś·tā ḵə·nā·p̄e·ḵā ‘al- ’ă·mā·ṯə·ḵā kî ’āt·tāh ḡō·’êl
verses.literal: Who are you he asked I [am] your servant Ruth she replied Spread the corner of your garment over me for you are a kinsman-redeemer

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לַֽיהוָה֙ בְּרוּכָ֨ה אַ֤תְּ בִּתִּ֔י הֵיטַ֛בְתְּ חַסְדֵּ֥ךְ הָאַחֲר֖וֹן מִן־ הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן לְבִלְתִּי־ לֶ֗כֶת אַחֲרֵי֙ הַבַּ֣חוּרִ֔ים אִם־ עָשִֽׁיר׃ וְאִם־ דַּ֖ל
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh bə·rū·ḵāh ’at bit·tî hê·ṭaḇt ḥas·dêḵ hā·’a·ḥă·rō·wn min- hā·ri·šō·wn lə·ḇil·tî- le·ḵeṯ ’a·ḥă·rê hab·ba·ḥū·rîm ’im- ‘ā·šîr wə·’im- dal
verses.literal: Then [Boaz] said May the LORD bless you my daughter You have shown more kindness now than before because you have not run after the younger men whether rich or poor

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֗ה אַל־ תִּ֣ירְאִ֔י בִּתִּי֙ אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֑ךְ כֹּ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאמְרִ֖י כִּ֤י כָּל־ עַמִּ֔י שַׁ֣עַר יוֹדֵ֙עַ֙ כִּ֛י אָֽתְּ׃ אֵ֥שֶׁת חַ֖יִל
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh ’al- tî·rə·’î bit·tî ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ kōl ’ă·šer- tō·mə·rî kî kāl- ‘am·mî ša·‘ar yō·w·ḏê·a‘ kî ’āt ’ê·šeṯ ḥa·yil
verses.literal: And now do not be afraid my daughter I will do for you whatever - you request since all my fellow townspeople . . . know that you are a woman of noble character

verses.original: וְעַתָּה֙ כִּ֣י אָמְנָ֔ם כִּ֥י אָנֹ֑כִי אם גֹאֵ֖ל וְגַ֛ם יֵ֥שׁ גֹּאֵ֖ל קָר֥וֹב מִמֶּֽנִּי׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh kî ’ā·mə·nām kî ’ā·nō·ḵî m ḡō·’êl wə·ḡam yêš gō·’êl qā·rō·wḇ mim·men·nî
verses.literal: - Yes it is true that I [am] a kinsman-redeemer but there is a redeemer nearer than I

verses.original: לִ֣ינִי׀ הַלַּ֗יְלָה וְהָיָ֤ה בַבֹּ֙קֶר֙ אִם־ יִגְאָלֵ֥ךְ טוֹב֙ יִגְאָ֔ל וְאִם־ לֹ֨א יַחְפֹּ֧ץ לְגָֽאֳלֵ֛ךְ יְהוָ֑ה חַי־ אָנֹ֖כִי וּגְאַלְתִּ֥יךְ שִׁכְבִ֖י עַד־ הַבֹּֽקֶר׃
verses.transliteration: lî·nî hal·lay·lāh wə·hā·yāh ḇab·bō·qer ’im- yiḡ·’ā·lêḵ ṭō·wḇ yiḡ·’āl wə·’im- lō yaḥ·pōṣ lə·ḡā·’o·lêḵ Yah·weh ḥay- ’ā·nō·ḵî ū·ḡə·’al·tîḵ šiḵ·ḇî ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer
verses.literal: Stay here tonight . . . . . . and in the morning if he wants to redeem you good Let him redeem you But if he does not want to redeem you as surely as the LORD lives I will Now lie here until morning

verses.original: וַתִּשְׁכַּ֤ב מַרְגְּלֹתָו עַד־ הַבֹּ֔קֶר וַתָּ֕קָם בִּטְרוֹם אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ רֵעֵ֑הוּ יַכִּ֥יר וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אַל־ יִוָּדַ֔ע כִּי־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בָ֥אָה הַגֹּֽרֶן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiš·kaḇ mar·gə·lō·ṯå̄w ‘aḏ- hab·bō·qer wat·tā·qām biṭ·rōm ’îš ’eṯ- rê·‘ê·hū yak·kîr way·yō·mer ’al- yiw·wā·ḏa‘ kî- hā·’iš·šāh ḇā·’āh hag·gō·ren
verses.literal: So she lay down at his feet until morning but she got up before anyone - else could recognize her Then Boaz said Do not let it be known that a woman came to the threshing floor

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר הָ֠בִי הַמִּטְפַּ֧חַת אֲשֶׁר־ עָלַ֛יִךְ וְאֶֽחֳזִי־ בָ֖הּ וַתֹּ֣אחֶז בָּ֑הּ וַיָּ֤מָד שֵׁשׁ־ שְׂעֹרִים֙ וַיָּ֣שֶׁת עָלֶ֔יהָ וַיָּבֹ֖א הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·ḇî ham·miṭ·pa·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·la·yiḵ wə·’e·ḥo·zî- ḇāh wat·tō·ḥez bāh way·yā·māḏ šêš- śə·‘ō·rîm way·yā·šeṯ ‘ā·le·hā way·yā·ḇō hā·‘îr
verses.literal: And he told her Bring the shawl - you are wearing and hold it out When she [did so] . . . he poured in six [measures] of barley and placed it on her Then he went into the city

verses.original: וַתָּבוֹא֙ אֶל־ חֲמוֹתָ֔הּ וַתֹּ֖אמֶר מִי־ אַ֣תְּ בִּתִּ֑י וַתַּ֨גֶּד־ לָ֔הּ אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָאִֽישׁ׃ עָֽשָׂה־ לָ֖הּ
verses.transliteration: wat·tā·ḇō·w ’el- ḥă·mō·w·ṯāh wat·tō·mer mî- ’at bit·tî wat·tag·geḏ- lāh ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer hā·’îš ‘ā·śāh- lāh
verses.literal: When Ruth returned to her mother-in-law Naomi asked her How did it go . . . my daughter Then Ruth told her - all that [Boaz] had done for her

verses.original: וַתֹּ֕אמֶר נָ֣תַן לִ֑י הָאֵ֖לֶּה שֵׁשׁ־ הַשְּׂעֹרִ֥ים כִּ֚י אָמַ֣רֵַ֔ אַל־ תָּב֥וֹאִי אֶל־ חֲמוֹתֵֽךְ׃ רֵיקָ֖ם
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·mer nā·ṯan lî hā·’êl·leh šêš- haś·śə·‘ō·rîm kî ʾå̄·ma·ra ’al- tā·ḇō·w·’î ’el- ḥă·mō·w·ṯêḵ rê·qām
verses.literal: And she said He gave me these six measures of barley for he said Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed

verses.original: שְׁבִ֣י בִתִּ֔י וַתֹּ֙אמֶר֙ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֵּֽדְעִ֔ין אֵ֖יךְ דָּבָ֑ר יִפֹּ֣ל כִּ֣י הָאִ֔ישׁ לֹ֤א יִשְׁקֹט֙ כִּֽי־ אִם־ כִּלָּ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר הַיּֽוֹם׃
verses.transliteration: šə·ḇî ḇit·tî wat·tō·mer ‘aḏ ’ă·šer tê·ḏə·‘în ’êḵ dā·ḇār yip·pōl kî hā·’îš lō yiš·qōṭ kî- ’im- kil·lāh had·dā·ḇār hay·yō·wm
verses.literal: Wait my daughter said Naomi until - you find out how things go for he will not rest unless . . . he has resolved the matter today
